looks.desc: Brash young bandit.

arc.text: Offers to help Ye Fan take his cauldron back from the Jiang family.
Storms Liuxiang Island with Ye Fan and wields Jiang Yi's Divine Wood Token.
Listed by Li Heishui among the fallen.

name: Jiang Huai'an
intro: A Dragon Transformation member of the ancient Jiang family who covers for Jiang Yichen.

power.detail: Wheel Sea shattered, Dao Palace intact

looks.label: Jiang clan elder
looks.desc: Jiang clansman in family robes.

looks.label: Sealed in a latrine
looks.desc: Crippled and sealed away.
looks.why: Ye Fan seals him in a latrine for a hundred years

arc.text: Leaks the cauldron's return to the Wanchu and Zifu Holy Sons.
Ye Fan breaks his Wheel Sea and seals him in a latrine for a hundred years.

name: Ouyang Ye
intro: A master of the Source Master family at Yaochi, said to be close to the level of an Earth Source Master.

looks.label: Old source master
looks.desc: Crafty old source master.

arc.text: Seals one King Stone but flees the Nine-Aperture Human Stone and sabotages Ye Fan's patterns.
Ye Fan makes him trigger the Ancient True Demon Domain.
Flatters Ye Fan at Qinling while plotting to take his Heaven Source Scripture.

name: Wanchu Holy Lord
intro: The Immortal Platform lord of Wanchu Holy Land, watching Ye Fan at the Yaochi Grand Gathering.

looks.label: Wanchu Holy Lord
looks.desc: Holy-land master in Wanchu robes.

arc.text: Accuses Ye Fan of being the Ruthless heir and is shut in the Ancient True Demon Domain; his death is confirmed in EP139.

name: Queen Mother of the West
intro: The present Immortal Platform head of Yaochi Holy Land, bearing the title of the Queen Mother of the West; not the ancient Great Emperor of the same title.

looks.label: Queen Mother of Yaochi
looks.desc: Dignified woman in Yaochi robes.

arc.text: Thanks Ye Fan for helping reseal the King Stones but warns she can't protect him outside Yaochi.
Won't openly take sides, but suppresses Wang Zheng with the Xihuang Pagoda.
Recommends Ye Fan to the Qishi Academy.

name: Ou Luotian
intro: The Wanchu Holy Lord's younger brother, an Immortal Platform master.

power.detail: the Holy Lord's younger brother
power.note: captioned only as the Holy Lord's younger brother

looks.label: Wanchu Holy Lord's brother
looks.desc: Holy-land master in Wanchu robes.

arc.text: Demands Ye Fan's death for the Dragon Nest deaths and is killed by the Peacock King in two moves.

name: Dongfang Taiyi
intro: An ancient saint found sealed in the Ten Thousand Dragon Nest.

power.detail: a sealed ancient saint
power.note: the wiki calls him a peak Great Saint (novel)

looks.label: Sealed saint
looks.desc: Ancient figure sealed in the dragon lair.

looks.label: Dharma-form phantom
looks.desc: A towering phantom of him that scares off the Thousand-Armed Divine Demon.

arc.text: His phantom scares off the Thousand-Armed Divine Demon.

name: Jin Chixiao
intro: The heir of the Golden (Huangjin) ancient family, among the holy sons of the Kill-Saint Alliance.

looks.label: Golden family heir
looks.desc: Golden-haired young ancient-clan prodigy.

arc.text: Dies as the secret of the red-haired monster is uncovered.

name: Crow Daoist
intro: An old demon Daoist of the crow line.

looks.label: Crow Daoist
looks.desc: Old Daoist with crow-black robes.

arc.text: With the Peacock King and Red Dragon Daoist, fights three saint-lord-level elders to protect Ye Fan.

name: Yu Die
intro: A princess of the Central States whom Ye Fan saves on arrival.

looks.label: Princess
looks.desc: Graceful princess in Central States court robes.

arc.text: Ye Fan saves her and ends up lord of a cursed fief next to the Qishi Academy.
Helps Ye Fan and Dongfang Ye knock out and loot Duan De.

name: Dongfang Ye
intro: A hulking, straightforward young barbarian from the Southern Ridge whom Ye Fan meets in the Central States.

looks.label: Barbarian youth
looks.desc: Muscular bronze-skinned barbarian youth.

arc.text: Explores the Immortal Burial Ground with Ye Fan and Duan De.
His barbarian tribe is attacked by the Wang clan when Ye Fan returns.

name: Xiao Mingyuan
intro: Elder Xiao's grandson in the Anping Kingdom, angered when Ye Fan picks Lu City, the Xiao clan's old fief.

looks.label: Xiao clan heir
looks.desc: Cruel young noble of the Xiao clan.

arc.text: Returns with a healed Yan Yunluan for revenge and tries to blood-sacrifice Lu City; Ye Fan kills him.

name: Qi Huoshui
intro: A bewitching young woman of the Demon Emperor Palace, 'the pearl of the Southern Ridge'.

looks.label: Demon Emperor Palace beauty
looks.desc: Bewitching young woman in red-and-black robes.

arc.text: Beaten by Ye Fan and made his maid.

name: Yan Yunluan
intro: An arrogant Dragon Transformation genius who claims the Heaven-Earth-Human seals and the Wanshang Bow as his.

power.detail: breaks through a level mid-fight

looks.label: Arrogant genius
looks.desc: Haughty young cultivator with a great bow.

arc.text: Beaten by Ye Fan with his own bow.
Returns with Xiao Mingyuan; Ye Fan takes over his heavenly tribulation to reach Dragon Transformation.

name: Blind Old Man of Heaven
aka: Second Great Bandit of the Northern Plains
intro: A blind old map-seller who sells maps of the Immortal Burial Ground and leads Ye Fan's group inside.

power.detail: strength unreadable

looks.label: Blind map-seller
looks.desc: Blind old man hawking maps.

arc.text: Uses the crowds he sold maps to as trap-clearers and leads a chant that pacifies the God's Thought.
Reveals himself as the Second Great Bandit of the Northern Plains.
Joins Ye Fan and Duan De in exploring Purple Mountain.
Gives Ye Fan Wu Shi's jade so he can get out.

name: Wang Teng
intro: The 'Northern Emperor' of the Northern Plains Wang clan, the most feared young master of his generation.

power.detail: a peerless young prodigy; the movie shows him at Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven

looks.label: Divine sense
looks.desc: Seen first only as a projected divine sense.

looks.label: Northern Emperor
looks.desc: Commanding young man in regal battle robes.

arc.text: Appears in person and squares up to Ye Fan as three great weapons face off.
Their long feud properly begins.
Ye Fan defeats him in the movie 'Fighting Wang Teng with the Coffin', set between EP156 and EP157.

note: Earlier text said he was killed in the movie, but he is on screen at 2nd Heaven in EP177.

name: Wang Chong
intro: A Dragon Transformation prodigy of the Northern Plains Wang clan, sent when the Xiao clan asks the Wang family for help.

looks.label: Wang clan prodigy
looks.desc: Proud young noble of the Wang clan.

arc.text: Attacks with a king-grade war chariot; crushed by Ye Fan, who takes it. Wang Teng's divine sense saves him.
Scolded and confined for a year by Wang Teng.
Enters Qinling with a holy talisman and turns on Ye Fan at the dragon marrow.
Fights Ye Fan again with a Luan Gu Emperor talisman.

name: Azure Emperor
intro: The last demon-race Great Emperor, whose tomb, heart and weapon drive the early story; here seen as a manifestation.

looks.label: Manifestation
looks.desc: Towering manifestation of the Azure Emperor.

arc.text: His 'one azure lotus through the ages' takes centre stage.

name: Qi Lin
intro: The 'Southern Demon' of the Southern Ridge's Demon Emperor Palace, a feared young master.

looks.label: Southern Demon
looks.desc: Aloof young master of the Demon Emperor Palace.

arc.text: Courted by the Wang clan head Wang Chengkun to join the ancient clans.

name: Sun Holy Emperor
intro: The lingering divine will of an ancient human Holy Emperor, found in space with his coffin.

power.detail: a Sovereign of the Supreme Ancient era (lingering will)

looks.label: Divine will
looks.desc: Radiant, sun-like phantom of an ancient emperor.

arc.text: His lingering divine will passes nine ancient characters and a blessing to Ye Fan.
Ye Fan rescues his last descendant, Ye Tong.

name: Yin Tianzhi
intro: An arrogant young master of Ziwei's Bajing Palace, younger brother of its lord.

looks.label: Bajing young master
looks.desc: Cold-eyed young man in a five-coloured dragon robe.

arc.text: Provokes Ye Fan and is crushed by Taiyin power and the Mother Qi Cauldron.

name: Li Tian
intro: A shameless cultivator of Ziwei's Human Desire Dao.

looks.label: Human Desire Dao cultivator
looks.desc: Scruffy, grinning middle-aged cultivator.

arc.text: Teams up with Ye Fan with his senior Yan Yixi.
Traps Yi Qingwu and Ye Fan inside the Goddess Furnace.
Returns to Beidou with Ye Fan.

name: Golden Crow Ninth Prince
intro: A prince of Ziwei's Golden Crow clan, who with his Sixth Brother decides to shelter at home as the ancient clans approach.

looks.label: Golden Crow prince
looks.desc: Golden Crow clan prince.

arc.text: Beaten by Ye Fan in a duel at Sky Wolf Palace's feast; his death is implied.

name: Thousand-Armed Divine Demon
intro: A monstrous being sleeping on an ancient warship drifting in space.

looks.label: Sleeping demon
looks.desc: Many-armed colossal demon asleep on an ancient warship.

arc.text: Scared off by Dongfang Taiyi's phantom.

name: Golden Crow First Prince
aka: First Crown Prince of the Golden Crows
intro: The Golden Crow clan's First Crown Prince, who watches from a cliff as the ancient clans' warship arrives and chooses to stay out.

looks.label: Golden Crow crown prince
looks.desc: Regal Golden Crow prince.

arc.text: Learns Ye Fan escaped the North Sea Eye and vows to finish what Lu Ya could not.

name: Yin Tiande
intro: The lord of Ziwei's Bajing Palace, Yin Tianzhi's elder brother and Yi Qingwu's betrothed.

looks.label: Bajing Palace lord
looks.desc: Short, ordinary-looking man with his brother's eyes.

arc.text: Summons a Green Ox (Laozi's mount) in the scripture war at Ascension Cliff.

name: Yan Yixi
intro: A charming white-clad scholar of the Human Desire Dao in Ziwei.

looks.label: White-clad scholar
looks.desc: Handsome young man in white with a scholar's air.

arc.text: Returns to Beidou with Ye Fan.

name: Lu Ya
intro: A Golden Crow crown prince of Ziwei.

looks.label: Golden Crow prince
looks.desc: Proud prince wreathed in golden-crow fire.

arc.text: Ambushes Ye Fan with a pill granting ten Golden Crows' power and is killed.

name: Yi Qingwu
intro: Guanghan Palace's Yi Qingwu, Ziwei's greatest beauty and the betrothed of Bajing Palace's lord.

looks.label: Guanghan Palace beauty
looks.desc: Ethereal woman in Guanghan Palace robes.

arc.text: Traps Ye Fan in a twelve-heavenly-stem array; he breaks out.
After the Human Desire tribulation in the furnace, allies with Ye Fan.
Says goodbye as Ye Fan leaves Ziwei.

name: Heavenly Demon Granny
intro: An old demoness of Ziwei who joins the scramble for the map fragments and wants Ye Fan's Holy Body blood.

power.detail: early stage (on her clone)

looks.label: Eight-armed incarnation
looks.desc: Eight-armed clone of the old demoness.

looks.label: True body
looks.desc: The Granny in her true body.
looks.why: her real body ambushes them nine days later

arc.text: Her true body ambushes Ye Fan's group and is killed by the Goddess Furnace; they loot her treasures.

name: Taiyin Divine Son
intro: A young power of Ziwei in Yin Tiande's circle, who ambushes Ye Fan with the Heavenly Demon Granny.

looks.label: Taiyin Divine Son
looks.desc: Young master of the Taiyin (moon) path.

arc.text: Joins Lu Ya and Priest San Que in joining the 36 map fragments.
Attacks Ye Fan with a skull weapon of an Ancient Moon Queen descendant; Ye Fan seals it with Immortal Exile and takes it.

name: Ye Tong
intro: The last descendant of the Sun Holy Emperor, a boy rescued during the Golden Crow attack on the Sun Ancient Sect.

power.detail: a young beginner

looks.label: Boy disciple
looks.desc: Young boy of the Sun Ancient Sect.

arc.text: Taken as Ye Fan's first disciple and named Ye Tong.
Comes to Beidou with Ye Fan.

name: Zi Tianfeng
intro: A young master of Shenling Valley, an ancient clan stronghold.

looks.label: Shenling Valley heir
looks.desc: Haughty ancient-clan young master.

arc.text: Killed by Ye Fan with the Six-Path Samsara Fist and the Nine Secrets.

name: Golden Crow King
intro: The king of Ziwei's Golden Crow clan, first seen as a dharma body whom Lu Ya asks for the forbidden Ten Golden Crows pill.

looks.label: Dharma body
looks.desc: Towering golden-crow dharma body of the king.

arc.text: His projection scolds Lu Ya, says he cut 60% of the pill's effect, and declares the karma settled.
Appears at Ascension Immortal Cliff to seize the Divine Spirit Ancient Scripture.

name: Qing Niu
intro: The Divine Ox King, Laozi's green ox mount, summoned by Yin Tiande with a Qin-era seal script.

power.detail: summoned only for an hour

looks.label: Green ox
looks.desc: Shining green divine ox.

arc.text: Fights for Yin Tiande in the scramble for the Divine Spirit Ancient Scripture.

name: Dongfang Man
intro: Dongfang Ye's younger brother, leading the barbarian tribe's hopeless last stand against the Wang clan at the Tushi Mountains.

looks.label: Barbarian warrior
looks.desc: Muscular young barbarian warrior.

arc.text: Saved when Ye Fan kills the Wang 13th Elder.
Leads the blood sacrifice to blow the Qiongtian war horn and wake the tribe.
Ye Fan promises to take him to kill Zi Tianfeng.
Takes Ye Fan to the wounded Li Heishui.

name: Wang Chengkun
intro: The head of the Northern Plains Wang clan and Wang Teng's father.

looks.label: Wang clan head
looks.desc: Imposing clan patriarch.

arc.text: Lured out and killed by Ye Fan with eight great-power elders.

name: Wang Chengtian
intro: An elder of the Northern Plains Wang clan who swears a blood oath to avenge the beheaded family head.

power.detail: level 9

looks.label: Wang clan elder
looks.desc: Stern Wang clan elder.

arc.text: Leads a hundred thousand Wang cavalry into the barbarian heartland and faces Ye Fan.

name: Wang Lie
intro: An ancient of the Northern Plains Wang clan with 3,700 years of cultivation, who comes out of seclusion as the barbarians attack.

looks.label: Wang ancient
looks.desc: Aged Wang clan ancestor.

arc.text: Ye Fan copies his Beast King Fist and kills him with the Six-Path Samsara Fist.

name: Barbarian King
intro: The king of the Southern Ridge barbarian clans.

looks.label: Barbarian king
looks.desc: Massive barbarian warlord.

arc.text: Warns Ye Fan about the North Pole once the Wang clan has fallen.

name: Dark Demon King
intro: The Wang clan's founding ancestor, a Dark Body who survived the end of his lifespan by sealing himself in Divine Source for 1,500 years.

looks.label: Sealed ancestor
looks.desc: Ancient Wang clan ancestor emerging from his Divine Source seal.

arc.text: Holds off the Barbarian King until Ye Fan cuts him off from his Divine Source, then spends his remaining life on a North Pole Immortal Light.

name: Heavenly Emperor's Son
intro: The son of the Undying Heavenly Emperor, emerging among the ancient clans.

looks.label: Imperial heir
looks.desc: Regal young ancient-clan heir.

name: Divine Spirit Valley Ancestral King
intro: The Saint-realm Ancestral King of Divine Spirit Valley, Zi Tianfeng's clan.

looks.label: Ancestral King
looks.desc: Ancient-clan Saint on his throne.

arc.text: Shaken by a jade record of the 'Mad Emperor' killing three Great Saints.
Held back by his elders until the Heavenly Emperor's Son orders the barbarian tribe destroyed.
